chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ismail ibn Abd al-Khaliq, who said:

A man from the companions of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was delayed from him, then he came to him. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: 'What delayed you from us?' He said: 'Illness and poverty.' He said to him: 'Shall I not teach you a supplication by which Allah will remove from you the illness and poverty?' He said: 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah.'

He said: 'Say: There is no might and no power except with Allah, the Exalted, the Magnificent. I have placed my trust in the Living Who does not die, and all praise is for Allah Who did not take a companion nor a son, and there was no partner for Him in the dominion, and there was no guardian for Him from the disgrace, and exalt Him with great exaltation.'
So it was not long before he returned to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, Allah has indeed removed from me the illness and poverty.'

key_terms.الْحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ: The Living Who does not die (Divine Attribute)

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for removing illness and poverty taught by the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, the Prophet teaches a companion a comprehensive supplication combining the declaration of divine power (*La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah*) with attributes of Allah found in Surah Al-Ikhlas, specifically addressing both spiritual and material needs. This du'a is significant in Shia tradition as a means to alleviate sickness and poverty by affirming Allah's absolute sovereignty and self-sufficiency. The immediate recovery of the companion underscores the practical efficacy of this specific invocation in removing worldly hardships.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ismail Bin Abdul Khaliq who said,

‘A man from the companions of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> was delay from him<sup>saww</sup>. Then he came over to him<sup>saww</sup>. So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to him: ‘What delayed you from us<sup>saww</sup>?’ So he said, ‘The illness and the poverty’. So he<sup>saww</sup> said to him: ‘So, shall I<sup>saww</sup> teach you a supplication by which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will Remove from you, the illness and the poverty?’ He said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’.

So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘Say, 
‘There is neither Might nor Strength except with Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, the Exalted, the Magnificent. I rely upon the Living Who will not be dying, and the Praise is for Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Who neither Took a female companion, nor a son, and there does not happent to be an associate for Him<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> in the Kingdom, and there does not happen to be a guardian for Him<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> from the disgrace, and I exclaim Greatness to Him with an exclamation’.

He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘So it was not long before he returned to the Prophet<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> and he said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>! Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> has Removed from me, the illness and the poverty’’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Isma’Il ibn ‘Abd al-Khaliq who has said the following:

“Once one of the companions of the Holy Prophet delayed and when he came, the Messenger of Allah asked, ‘What caused you to delay?’ He replied, ‘Illness and poverty.’ He then said, ‘Should I teach you a supplication with which Allah will remove illness and poverty from you?’ He said, ‘Yes, O the Messenger of Allah, please do so.’

The Messenger of Allah told him to say, ‘There are no means and no power without Allah, the Most High, the Most Great, I place my trust before the living One Who does not die, all praise belongs to Allah Who has not taken anyone as His companion or a child, Who has no partner in His kingdom, and there has never been any supporter for Him against humiliation, and speak of His greatness a great deal.’
“The narrator has said that very shortly thereafter the man came to the Holy Prophet saying, ‘O Messenger of Allah, He has removed from me illness and poverty.’”
